translations.b0186: Part 7  Expanding High-Level Opening Up and Opening New Prospects for Win-Win Cooperation
translations.b0187: China will uphold openness, cooperation and mutual benefit, steadily expand institutional opening up, build a new system of a higher-standard open economy, advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, expand international circulation, promote reform and development through opening up, advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, and share opportunities and pursue common development with all countries.
translations.b0188: Chapter 21  Actively Expanding Self-Initiated Opening Up
translations.b0189: China will expand opening up in alignment with high-standard international economic and trade rules, promote connectivity and compatibility between domestic and international rules, regulations, management and standards, and foster a transparent, stable and predictable institutional environment.
translations.b0190: Section 1  Orderly Expanding the Sectors and Regions Open to the World
translations.b0191: With the services sector as the focus, China will expand market access and the areas open to foreign participation, opening up on a larger scale, in wider fields and at greater depth. It will promote the orderly expansion of opening up in telecommunications, the internet, education, culture, healthcare and other fields, prudently carry out pilot opening programs in value-added telecommunications, biotechnology, wholly foreign-owned hospitals and other areas, and advance comprehensive pilot demonstrations for expanding the opening up of the services sector. It will shorten the negative list for foreign investment access and strengthen coordination between negative list revision and opening up pilots. It will steadily and prudently expand mutual connectivity of financial markets, improve the qualified foreign investor system, broaden the range of investable products, orderly advance two-way cross-border direct financing by eligible enterprises, and support cross-border investment by equity investment funds. It will promote the efficient, convenient and secure cross-border flow of data. It will improve visa and residence policies and make digital services more convenient for foreign nationals entering China. It will advance renminbi internationalization, expand the use of the renminbi in international trade and investment and financing, raise the level of capital account opening, build an independent and controllable cross-border renminbi payment system, and develop offshore renminbi markets. In fields where conditions permit, China will take the lead in implementing the opening up measures of high-standard economic and trade agreements and will, for the least developed countries and economic and trade partners with strong potential for cooperation, expand the sectors and regions covered by unilateral opening up.
translations.b0192: Section 2  Building Institutional and Regulatory Systems Compatible with High-Standard Economic and Trade Rules
translations.b0193: China will promote efficient coordination between high-level opening up and in-depth reform and accelerate legislation and legal amendments, policy adjustments and standard revisions in key fields. It will improve intellectual property protection mechanisms aligned with international rules, explore expanding the scope of trademark protection, improve copyright protection mechanisms, and broaden channels for resolving intellectual property disputes. It will promote international mutual recognition of rules and standards for key products, including energy efficiency, water efficiency and carbon footprint, and advance the disclosure of corporate climate and environmental information in accordance with the law as well as voluntary disclosure. It will explore ways to improve labor protection mechanisms that suit China’s national conditions and conform to international practice. It will accelerate reform of the government procurement system and fully implement the principle of fair competition. It will take the lead in piloting the WTO Agreement on Electronic Commerce and the Agreement on Investment Facilitation, and improve the efficiency of cross-border payment and settlement as well as the level of electronic and standardized documentation.
translations.b0194: Section 3  Improving the Regional Layout of Opening Up
translations.b0195: China will build open highlands of diverse forms and accelerate the creation of a comprehensive opening up pattern in which land and sea, and domestic and international markets, are interconnected and the eastern and western regions reinforce each other. It will build the Hainan Free Trade Port to high standards, implement island-wide special customs operations at a high level, continue to raise the level of opening up in key areas such as trade, investment and the flow of production factors, and gradually establish a policy and institutional system suited to a high-standard free trade port. It will implement the strategy for upgrading pilot free trade zones, carry out more vigorous experiments in institutional opening up, and strengthen their capacity to drive development through innovation. It will make coordinated plans for the development of major opening up and cooperation platforms for scientific and technological innovation, trade in services and industrial development, support the optimization and integration of platforms with similar functions in neighboring locations, promote innovation in the management systems and operating models of state-level new areas and development zones, facilitate the transformation and upgrading of comprehensive bonded zones, and advance the building of key development and opening up pilot zones in border areas, industrial collaboration parks, border and near-port industrial parks, and border (cross-border) economic cooperation zones.
translations.b0196: Chapter 22  Improving the Quality and Level of Trade and Investment Cooperation
translations.b0197: China will strengthen coordination between imports and exports, place equal importance on goods and services, coordinate efforts to attract foreign investment with outbound investment, and foster new strengths in international trade and two-way investment cooperation.
translations.b0198: Section 1  Promoting Innovative Development of Trade
translations.b0199: China will move faster to build itself into a strong trading nation, improve the quality and efficiency of foreign trade, and promote balanced development of imports and exports. It will optimize and upgrade trade in goods, diversify markets, expand trade in intermediate goods, and upgrade processing trade. It will vigorously develop trade in services, improve the negative list management system for cross-border trade in services, relax restrictions on cross-border services such as cross-border delivery and the movement of natural persons, encourage service exports, strengthen the international competitiveness of transport, travel and other services, develop knowledge-intensive trade in services, actively develop service outsourcing, and raise the standardization level of trade in services. It will appropriately adjust import tariff rates, revise the catalogue of technologies, products and services encouraged for import, and expand imports of advanced technology and equipment, high-quality agricultural products, producer services and other goods and services that are urgently needed domestically. It will develop digital trade and green trade through innovation and orderly expand opening up in the digital field. It will support the development of new business forms and models such as cross-border e-commerce, improve the layout and functions of overseas warehouses, and improve the policy environment for bonded maintenance and remanufacturing, new types of offshore trade and other activities. It will advance regulatory innovation in customs clearance, taxation and foreign exchange, and promote international cooperation on standards, conformity assessment, and inspection and quarantine for foreign trade products. It will enhance the functions of trade promotion platforms, increase support through export credit and credit insurance, and continue to host major exhibitions such as the China International Import Expo, the China Import and Export Fair and the China International Fair for Trade in Services. It will promote the integrated development of domestic and foreign trade and deepen reform of standards and certification for domestic and foreign trade. It will strengthen trade risk prevention and control and responses to trade frictions, enrich policy tools such as trade adjustment assistance and trade remedies, and improve the export control system.
translations.b0200: Section 2  Attracting and Utilizing Foreign Investment with Greater Effort
translations.b0201: China will continue to improve the environment for foreign investment, improve its service and support system for foreign investment, and foster new strengths in attracting foreign investment. It will fully implement national treatment for foreign-funded enterprises, clean up documents and regulations inconsistent with the Foreign Investment Law, and ensure that market access is matched by permission to operate. It will leverage the demonstration effect of landmark foreign investment projects, guide more foreign investment toward advanced manufacturing, modern services, high and new technologies, energy conservation and environmental protection and other fields, support foreign-funded enterprises in joining upstream and downstream supporting cooperation within industrial chains, and vigorously attract them to set up regional headquarters and R&D centers in China. It will encourage foreign investors to reinvest in China. It will carefully cultivate the “Invest in China” brand. It will expand the ways in which foreign investment is utilized, improve the administration of foreign mergers and acquisitions, and broaden channels for foreign investment in the securities market. It will conduct foreign investment security reviews with high quality. It will improve the full-scope foreign debt supervision system and the statistics and information reporting systems for foreign investment, and strengthen information sharing.
translations.b0202: Section 3  Promoting International Industrial and Investment Cooperation
translations.b0203: China will effectively administer outbound investment, improve the comprehensive overseas service system, promote the integration of trade and investment, and guide the rational and orderly cross-border layout of industrial and supply chains. It will further guide and regulate the direction of enterprises’ overseas investment, support qualified enterprises in carrying out mutually beneficial overseas investment cooperation, and encourage enterprises in emerging industries such as internet platforms and artificial intelligence to expand overseas application scenarios. It will support professional service institutions providing consulting and evaluation, legal services, accounting and auditing, credit rating, mediation and arbitration in expanding their overseas service networks, and improve the system for protecting intellectual property rights in foreign-related matters. It will strengthen protection of the lawful overseas interests of Chinese citizens and legal persons, establish a system for responding to requests and for protection and relief, and improve the system for protecting overseas interests. It will give play to the role of overseas economic and trade cooperation zones and promote their coordinated development with domestic parks. It will strengthen security reviews of outbound investment and improve the mechanisms, laws and regulations for monitoring, preventing and handling outbound investment risks, and help enterprises improve their capacity for risk prevention and compliance management.
translations.b0204: Chapter 23  High-Quality Belt and Road Cooperation
translations.b0205: China will uphold the guiding principles of extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits, of openness, green development and integrity, and of high standards, improved living standards and sustainability; improve the mechanisms for advancing high-quality Belt and Road cooperation; and deepen “hard connectivity” of infrastructure, “soft connectivity” of rules and standards, and “heart connectivity” with the people of Belt and Road partner countries.
translations.b0206: Section 1  Deepening the Alignment of Development Strategies
translations.b0207: China will strengthen policy communication and strategic alignment with Belt and Road partner countries and international organizations, strengthen the coordinated management of cooperation plans, and enhance implementation coordination and evaluation. It will give play to the leading role of the Belt and Road Forum for International Cooperation and strengthen the development of cooperation platforms in energy, taxation, poverty reduction, think tanks, the media and other fields. It will deepen exchanges of governance experience with Belt and Road partner countries and increase exchanges among entrepreneurs, experts and scholars, young people and other groups. It will coordinate multilateral and bilateral cooperation, develop new models of Belt and Road cooperation, consolidate existing cooperation outcomes, and expand space for win-win development.
translations.b0208: Section 2  Improving the Layout of a Multidimensional Connectivity Network
translations.b0209: China will deepen cooperation on major economic corridors and hub ports and keep the diverse land, maritime, air and cyberspace channels open and unimpeded. It will raise the level of development of China-Europe (Central Asia) freight trains and actively participate in building the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route. It will build the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan Railway, the Hungary-Serbia Railway and other projects to high standards. It will advance the integrated development of ports, shipping and trade under the “Maritime Silk Road,” promote higher quality and greater efficiency in building the Air Silk Road, and strengthen cooperation on building the Space Information Corridor. It will actively promote the application of Chinese standards overseas. It will further advance the development of the core areas of the Belt and Road in Xinjiang and Fujian.
translations.b0210: Section 3  Comprehensively Improving the Quality and Effectiveness of Practical Cooperation
translations.b0211: China will continue to expand trade and investment cooperation with Belt and Road partner countries and build cooperation pilot zones for “Silk Road e-commerce” to high standards. It will open up new space for cooperation in green development, artificial intelligence, the digital economy, health, tourism, agriculture, meteorology, BeiDou applications and other fields. It will advance major landmark projects and “small and beautiful” livelihood projects in a coordinated manner. It will improve a diversified, sustainable and risk-controllable investment and financing system and actively support the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, the New Development Bank and the Silk Road Fund in playing their roles. It will expand channels for people-to-people and cultural exchanges with Belt and Road partner countries in culture, education, archaeology, sports and other fields, and implement the Belt and Road Science, Technology and Innovation Cooperation Action Plan to high standards. It will enhance its capacity for risk prevention and control, deepen efforts to build a clean Silk Road, and promote higher-quality Belt and Road cooperation that is more orderly, more standardized, safer and more sustainable.
translations.b0212: Chapter 24  Advancing the Building of a Community with a Shared Future for Mankind
translations.b0213: China will implement the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative, the Global Civilization Initiative and the Global Governance Initiative, actively advance major-country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics, and make China’s contribution to building a community with a shared future for mankind.
translations.b0214: Section 1  Actively Participating in and Leading Global Economic Governance
translations.b0215: China will advance reform of global economic and financial governance and work to build and uphold an international economic order that is fair and just, open and inclusive, and mutually beneficial. It will safeguard the multilateral trading system with the World Trade Organization at its core, participate comprehensively and in depth in WTO reform, and resolutely oppose protectionism, the arbitrary imposition of tariffs and similar practices. It will expand the global network of high-standard free trade areas, implement the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership to high standards and advance its enlargement and review processes, push for the implementation of version 3.0 of the China-ASEAN Free Trade Area, actively seek to join the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership and the Digital Economy Partnership Agreement, and promote the negotiation and signing of more regional and bilateral trade and investment agreements. It will actively put forward Chinese proposals for international rules in emerging fields such as artificial intelligence, the digital economy, green and low-carbon development, and outer space. It will strengthen international macroeconomic policy coordination, promote the role of the G20 as the premier forum for international economic cooperation, expand the influence of cooperation mechanisms such as BRICS and the Shanghai Cooperation Organization, actively participate in Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, and advance the building of the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific.
translations.b0216: Section 2  Promoting the Building of a New Type of International Relations
translations.b0217: China advocates and practices true multilateralism, firmly upholds the international system with the United Nations at its core, the international order based on international law, and the basic norms of international relations based on the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, and will expand its global network of partnerships and steer the international order toward greater fairness and justice. It will deepen integrated development in the neighborhood, strengthen common security, consolidate strategic mutual trust, and build a community with a shared future with neighboring countries. It will promote coordination and sound interaction among major countries and maintain the overall stability of major-country relations. It will deepen solidarity and cooperation with developing countries and support the Global South in seeking strength through unity. It will create multi-level, multi-field mechanisms and platforms for dialogue and exchanges among civilizations and work with others to build a global network for dialogue and cooperation among civilizations. It will promote the common values of humanity and work for a world of lasting peace, universal security, common prosperity, openness and inclusiveness, and clean and beautiful environments.
translations.b0218: Section 3  Providing More International Public Goods
translations.b0219: China will play its role as a responsible major country and take a more active part in addressing global issues such as climate change, transnational crime, cybersecurity, major infectious diseases and terrorism. It will resolutely oppose hegemonism, high-handedness and bullying, uphold international fairness and justice, and safeguard the common interests of the peoples of all countries. It will actively participate in formulating global security rules, take a constructive part in the political settlement of international and regional hotspot issues, strengthen international security cooperation in food, energy, data, biosafety, land and maritime corridors, counterterrorism and other fields, and promote the improvement of global security governance. It will promote global cooperation on poverty reduction, strengthen the development of the foreign aid system and full-chain management, and increase foreign aid. It will implement the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
